title: Dyson Spheres
summary: Isaac Arthur examines Dyson spheres and swarms, including common myths and misconceptions. He covers uses such as interstellar travel, black hole generation, and computing large enough to simulate universes.
why: HN references it in threads on megastructures, Kardashev civilizations and Dyson sphere detection, and recommends the channel for in-depth futurist content.

quote.text: Isaac Arthur's youtube channel goes into this in some depth (and is generally excellent, IMO).
